caption: The drawing depicts two views of a light-colored, long-sleeved women's jacket made of fabric with a subtle striped pattern. The main, larger view shows the back side of the jacket, highlighting its high collar, fitted shape, and peplum detail at the waist, as well as two decorative buttons placed above the peplum on either side. The sleeves are long and slightly tapered, ending in narrow cuffs. The fabric appears to have faint vertical white stripes running throughout the garment. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, separate inset drawing of the front view of the same jacket, which displays the wide lapels, double-breasted front with two sets of buttons, and the same striped pattern. The background is a uniform beige color with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Boy's Jacket
